name: medora-authority
description: React dashboard for the Medora Authority WordPress plugin.

scripts.check: npm run check-types && npm run lint:js && npm run test:unit

eslintConfigComment: jsdoc/require-param is written for JavaScript, where a docblock is the only place a parameter can be described. Here the types already declare them, and the rule's autofix writes empty `@param root0.value` stubs onto every destructured component — 45 of them in one run. A comment that repeats the signature and says nothing is worse than no comment, so the rule is off and the prose docblocks stay.
